entities.name: Reed C. Rollins
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Reed Clark Rollins was an American botanist, professor at Harvard University and one of the founders of both the International Association for Plant Taxonomy and the Organization for Tropical Studies. He was also the second president of each of them.
